backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for the store backend, defining data types and state for products, orders, carts, bills, recharge orders, and user profiles, with access-controlled query and update methods for managing all store operations.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping implemented features (homepage redesign, product grid layout, sticky bottom nav, etc.) to their associated source files, components, and test IDs with confidence ratings.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: A JSON-formatted text file containing one-sentence summaries of each frontend source file, serving as a reference document for the project's frontend component and hook inventory.
frontend/index.css: Global CSS entry point that imports Tailwind directives and defines CSS custom property tokens for light and dark themes including colors, radius, and sidebar variables.
frontend/index.html: HTML shell for the React SPA configured as a PWA for 'Maa Bhawani General Store', including viewport meta tags, Google Fonts (Inter), manifest link, and app icon references.
frontend/public/manifest.json: PWA web app manifest for 'Maa Bhawani General Store & Banking Point' specifying app name, icons, theme colors, standalone display mode, and portrait orientation.
frontend/public/service-worker.js: Service worker implementing cache-first strategy for static assets and network-first strategy for API calls, with install/activate lifecycle handlers to manage a versioned cache.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React application component that defines the TanStack Router route tree, mapping all application paths (home, checkout, admin, search, my-orders, wallet, etc.) to their page components within a shared Layout.
frontend/src/components/AdminGuard.tsx: A route guard component that restricts access to admin-only pages by verifying a hardcoded credential login with a 24-hour localStorage session, and also checks the caller's on-chain admin status via Internet Identity.
frontend/src/components/AdminProductForm: A form component for adding new products to the store, supporting fields like name, category, price, unit type, barcode (with scanner), stock quantity, and image upload with progress tracking.
frontend/src/components/AdminProductList: Displays a table of all products with inline stock editing, low-stock warnings, and the ability to remove products, using React Query mutations for backend updates.
frontend/src/components/BarcodeScanner.t: A camera-based barcode scanner component that loads Quagga2 from CDN, supports torch/flash toggling, haptic feedback, and beep audio on successful scan.
frontend/src/components/BillHistoryTable: Renders a searchable, filterable table of billing history with options to view, print, and export bills to CSV, displaying details like bill number, customer info, and payment status.
frontend/src/components/BillTemplate.tsx: Renders a printable bill template for Maa Bhawani General Store, displaying order items, totals, delivery charges, and a UPI QR code, with options to print or share via WhatsApp.
frontend/src/components/BottomNavBar.tsx: Fixed bottom navigation bar with four links (Home, Search, My Orders, Wallet) that highlights the active route using TanStack Router.
frontend/src/components/CallUsButton.tsx: Floating action button fixed to the bottom-right corner that initiates a phone call to the store's number.
frontend/src/components/CartDrawer.tsx: Slide-out cart drawer that displays cart items with quantity controls, handles item removal, calculates totals, and navigates to checkout while respecting shop open/closed status.
frontend/src/components/CategoryFilter.t: Horizontally scrollable row of category filter buttons that highlights the currently selected category and triggers a callback on selection.
Static alert component that displays the store's delivery fee policy (free above ₹51 within 1km, ₹5 below, ₹20/km beyond).
frontend/src/components/ErrorBoundary.ts: React class-based error boundary that catches render errors and displays a styled error message with stack trace details and reset/home actions.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Site footer displaying store name, contact info (phone and Google Maps link), delivery info, and a copyright notice with a caffeine.ai attribution link.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Sticky top header with store logo, shop open/closed indicator, cart icon with item count badge, admin dashboard link, and login/logout button using Internet Identity.
frontend/src/components/HeroBannerCarous: Auto-advancing image carousel with manual prev/next controls and dot indicators, cycling through two promotional store banners every 4 seconds.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main layout wrapper that renders Header, Footer, CallUsButton, and conditionally renders BottomNavBar and WhatsAppHelpButton for non-admin routes. Prefetches shop status to prevent banner flashing.
frontend/src/components/MobileRechargeSe: Displays a compact mobile recharge card with operator icons (Airtel, Jio, Vi, BSNL, MTNL) and opens a dialog form to submit a recharge order via the placeRecharge mutation.
frontend/src/components/PaymentQRCode.ts: Renders a payment details card showing the amount due, a UPI QR code image, and step-by-step payment instructions.
frontend/src/components/ProductCard.tsx: Displays a single product with image, price, delivery badge, and quantity controls (numeric input for kg/gram units, stepper for others), and handles adding the item to cart with shop-closed guard.
frontend/src/components/ProductGrid.tsx: Fetches and displays all products in a 2-column grid with category filtering, skeleton loading states, and a 'Coming Soon' empty state; passes shop-closed status to each ProductCard.
frontend/src/components/ShopClosedBanner: Shows an orange alert banner indicating the shop is closed only after the shop status has been successfully fetched and confirmed as closed.
frontend/src/components/ShopClosedChecko: Alert dialog that appears when the shop transitions from open to closed (or is triggered externally), prompting the user to return to the home page.
frontend/src/components/ShopStatusToggle: Admin card component that displays the current open/closed shop status from the server and provides a button to toggle it, showing loading and pending states.
frontend/src/components/WhatsAppHelpButt: Fixed floating button that links to a WhatsApp chat with the store's phone number, displayed above the bottom nav bar.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor using React Query, supporting both anonymous and authenticated (Internet Identity) usage, and invalidates dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an InternetIdentityProvider context and useInternetIdentity hook for managing ICP Internet Identity authentication, including login, logout, and identity persistence via AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Centralizes all React Query hooks (queries and mutations) for interacting with the backend actor, covering products, cart, bills, orders, recharge orders, and shop settings.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that sets up Tailwind base/components/utilities, defines light and dark theme CSS variables, and includes utility styles for touch, barcode scanner animation, and print layout.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin dashboard page with tabbed navigation for managing orders (with status progression), products, shop settings, and bill history, including an OrderCard component with Google Maps integration.
frontend/src/pages/AdminSettingsPage.tsx: Admin settings page allowing configuration of the store slogan, UPI ID for QR code payments, and an emergency shop close action.
frontend/src/pages/BillingPage.tsx: In-store billing page that allows adding products to a cart via search or barcode scan, entering customer details, and generating a printable bill.
frontend/src/pages/CheckoutPage.tsx: Checkout page that collects customer name, address, phone, and payment method, optionally captures GPS coordinates, and places an order while handling shop-closed scenarios.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Home page that composes a hero banner carousel, shop-closed banner, product grid, and mobile recharge section.
frontend/src/pages/MyOrdersPage.tsx: Placeholder page for order history, displaying a coming-soon message.
frontend/src/pages/OrderConfirmationPage: Order confirmation page that shows the order ID, payment method, and either a UPI QR code or cash-on-delivery instructions retrieved from session storage.
frontend/src/pages/SearchPage.tsx: Placeholder page for product search, displaying a coming-soon message.
frontend/src/pages/StoreDetailsPage.tsx: Static store details page showing contact info, hours, delivery policy, services, and an embedded Google Maps iframe for Maa Bhawani General Store.
frontend/src/pages/WalletPage.tsx: Placeholder page for wallet/cashback functionality, displaying a coming-soon message.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routes, with sessionStorage fallback support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration for the frontend, extending the default theme with custom colors (using oklch variables), border radii, fonts, shadows, and accordion animations, plus plugins for typography, container queries, and animate.
project_state.json: Tracks the current project state (version 3) for a mobile grocery/delivery app, documenting existing implemented features (homepage redesign, 2-column product grid, sticky bottom nav) and pending new feature requests with their statuses and image requirements.
